query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[2] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:46:00) hear me out. I am coming and I am bringing the suya. on God nobody is eating dry chicken on Christmas Day while I'm in the building. Aunty Nkechi I know you have the jollof covered but let me handle the meat. I'll bring my own grill if I have to 🔥
[3] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:08:00) My children, your Aunty Oby is speaking wisdom. And nobody thought to ask whether I need any help with the cooking this year? You know I will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but I will remember who did not ask. 🙂
[4] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:03:00) Chisom, I am glad you understand. This is a matter of how we have always operated as a family. Your grandfather insisted that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, the meal shared without rushing. That is what Christmas means in this family.
[5] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[6] (about=Adaeze, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Adaeze worries Nkechi is not eating properly due to gardening and asks if she is eating well.
[7] (about=Adaeze, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Adaeze asks Nkechi not to bury the lede when sharing health news.
[8] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka insists Nkechi is coming to Leeds and will collect her from Reading, making a weekend of it.
[9] (about=Nkechi, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Nkechi notes nobody asked whether she needs help with cooking this year, and she will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but will remember who did not ask.
[10] (about=Nkechi, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Nkechi enjoys gardening as a hobby and prefers it to watching television.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Nkechi will host Christmas again as always, will cook, and expects everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest.
[12] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli states that the family tradition, set by their grandfather, is that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, and the meal shared without rushing.
[13] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli states Adaeze does the fund chasing every year and suggests Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility, as Adaeze should not be chasing grown people for money alone.
agent_answer:
C. Ifeoma

Nkechi’s message singles out Ifeoma for having mentioned egusi with stockfish. Nkechi defuses any potential conflict by saying she has remembered it every year and then folds it into the settled menu: “ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish.” So Ifeoma’s difference is visible but absorbed into the meal rather than treated as a contested alternative.
